summary: Completed testing of Settings page functionality. All 13 backend API tests passed. Frontend testing verified all tabs (Profile, Security, Subscription), Settings link in both desktop and mobile menus, and cancel subscription dialog. Fixed a bug where password change form was not showing for email/password users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Settings page fully functional. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_settings.py cover user profile, password change, cancel subscription, and reactivate subscription endpoints.

features_tested.settings_page_loads: PASS - Settings page loads with user profile data
features_tested.profile_tab: PASS - Shows name and email fields with Save Changes button
features_tested.security_tab_password_form: PASS - Shows password change form for email/password users
features_tested.security_tab_google_message: PASS - Shows Google message for OAuth users (tested logic)
features_tested.subscription_tab: PASS - Shows Premium plan ($80/month), Unlimited book limit, Change Plan and Cancel Subscription buttons
features_tested.cancel_subscription_dialog: PASS - Opens confirmation dialog with Keep Subscription and Yes, Cancel buttons
features_tested.settings_link_desktop: PASS - Settings link appears in Library page user menu
features_tested.settings_link_mobile: PASS - Settings link appears in mobile menu

password_form_not_showing.issue: Password change form was not showing for email/password users because frontend checked for password_hash field which was not returned by API
password_form_not_showing.fix: Added has_password field to /user/profile API response and updated frontend to check has_password instead of password_hash
